scope: Offline visual-only review of three actual installed local preview screenshots. Phone captures are emulated; no browser, source or database access was performed. Paid construction evidence is separately from disposable V4 fixtures.

findings.observation: The initial capture showed a duplicate header. Independently inspected fresh, lower-scroll and settled-resize images show one header and readable cards. The separate native recheck reports one dialog/header, no horizontal overflow or errors, and successful lower-card scroll and Close. Source was unchanged; this is a capture artifact, not a source fix.
Six choices, prices, available kit count, rental continuity and review action are visible and readable.
The resident, home door, address and navigation controls are visible.

limitations: This is an independent offline review of stills; the native scrolling, Close and DOM checks were performed separately by the parent.
Phone views are emulated, not physical-device checks; no hosted-release claim. Paid construction evidence is separately from disposable V4 fixtures.
